lessons.title: Approximations and Errors

explanation_sections.title: Approximations and Errors
explanation_sections.body:
Approximation replaces a number with a nearby value. Absolute error = |approximate value − exact
value|.

questions.prompt: Estimate 49.8 × 20.2 by rounding each to the nearest whole number.
Measured length is 9.8 cm and reference length is 10 cm. Find absolute error.
Find percentage error if absolute error is 0.2 cm and reference length is 10 cm.
